display.title: Finale: The Ender Dragon
display.subtitle: Beat her and the pack is won
description: The Ender Dragon is the pack finale. She will not appear until you have
proven yourself in the End: reach the outer islands, travel 1000 blocks
out into End City territory, slay Shulkers and Endermen, then hold a Dragon
Summoning Crystal and sneak at the central fountain.
Ad Astra's planets do not wait for her: they open with Tier 4.
§7This is the last gate, with no token threshold beyond it. The Dragon
